params.prompt: Path to the source Excel workbook (blank = newest .xlsx in shared SA\Inputs)
Output workbook path (blank = SA\Outputs\app-integration-mapper\<input>_Integrations.xlsx)
Applications sheet name (blank = ExcelApplications)
Integration catalog sheet name (blank = Integration Catalog)
Application name column header (blank = Application Name)
Initiator app column header (blank = Initiator App)
Terminator app column header (blank = Terminator)
Include applications with zero integrations? (y/N)

skills.name: SAD (Solution Architecture Document) Generator
skills.description: Generate a Solution Architecture Document Word file from BRD/kickoff/SARB/questionnaire inputs, rewritten into confident executive-summary-quality prose (never raw source copy-paste), with per-requirement process diagrams and a polished swimlane-style high-level architecture diagram. Content-authoring heavy — run inside a Copilot CLI chat, not as a single script.
skills.note: Run via Copilot CLI: start a chat and say 'use the sad-document-generator skill' with the inputs below; the model authors the document interactively.
skills.outputs: A Word (.docx) Solution Architecture Document following the SBD SAD template, with per-requirement process/sequence diagrams (images + websequencediagrams.com scripts) and a companion architecture .pptx (swimlane-style, via the swimlane-flow-diagram toolkit).

params.prompt: Paths to BRD, kickoff deck, SARB deck, questionnaire, etc.
Output .docx path (blank = '<Project Name> - Solution Architecture Document.docx')
Are Ardoq Level 2 architecture diagram exports available? (y/N)
